desc:
🎉 Welcome to Hyper Tag! 🎉
Play fast-paced rounds as a Runner or Tagger, use powerful abilities, and compete across a wide variety of unique maps. 

💰 Earn lots of Coins by playing, tagging, and being the best!
⚡ Unlock new abilities to use on other players!
🌎 Explore various Maps and hone your skills to improve!
👥 Invite your friends and compete together!

⭐ Favorite the game and join the community to follow future updates!

⚠️ The game is still in its early stages! If you encounter any bugs or glitches, please report them in the group. ⚠️
